item.title: Costa Mesa AV Firm QSC Thrives Under New Owners
item.description: A broken-down motorcycle helped spark the founding of QSC, which has evolved from a boutique speaker firm favored by Led Zeppelin and The Doors into a fast-growing disruptor in the $300 billion audio-visual industry. The Costa Mesa-based firm supplies high-performance loudspeakers, digital mixers, power amplifiers and cutting-edge AV systems to theme parks, casinos and concert […] The post Costa Mesa AV Firm QSC Thrives Under New Owners appeared first on Orange County Business Journal.
